reviewFindings.verdict: PASS for the scoped static readiness fix
semantics: A fully ready world may complete its existing three consecutive requestAnimationFrame readiness samples even when the first sample arrives after WORLD_CAP.
A false readiness sample after WORLD_CAP still enters the existing visible error phase immediately; a partial ready streak does not extend the deadline.
Explicit underpaint failure remains immediate, retry starts a fresh attempt and still requires three ready samples, and normal title-to-scene-start progression remains covered.
The changed predicate gates timeout failure on !ready, so the cap remains bounded for unready worlds without falsely hiding a ready world during the stability frames.
